mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_round (id, match_id, game_id, game_no, status, black_user_id, white_user_id, attacker_user_id, turn_user_id, winner_user_id, move_count, last_move_at, rest_until, ready_user_ids, state_json, state_version, started_at, ends_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{matchId}, #{gameId}, #{gameNo}, #{status}, #{blackUserId}, #{whiteUserId}, #{attackerUserId}, #{turnUserId}, #{winnerUserId}, #{moveCount}, #{lastMoveAt}, #{restUntil}, #{readyUserIds}, #{stateJson}, #{stateVersion}, #{startedAt}, #{endsAt}, #{finishedAt})

INSERT INTO game_move (round_id, move_no, user_id, x, y, action, from_x, from_y, piece_type, piece_color, captured_piece_type, captured_piece_color, created_at) VALUES (#{roundId}, #{moveNo}, #{userId}, #{x}, #{y}, #{action}, #{fromX}, #{fromY}, #{pieceType}, #{pieceColor}, #{capturedPieceType}, #{capturedPieceColor}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM game_match WHERE status IN ('READY', 'RUNNING', 'REST') AND (player1_user_id = #{userId} OR player2_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE game_match SET status = 'READY' WHERE tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND stage = #{stage} AND round_no = #{roundNo} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_match WHERE tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND stage = #{stage} AND round_no = #{roundNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_match WHERE tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND stage = 'LEAGUE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_match WHERE tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND stage = 'LEAGUE' AND status IN ('FINISHED', 'BYE')
SELECT * FROM game_round WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND turn_user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY last_move_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE game_match SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{matchId}

UPDATE game_match SET first_game_id = COALESCE(first_game_id, #{gameId}), game_chooser_user_id = COALESCE(game_chooser_user_id, #{chooserUserId}) WHERE id = #{matchId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'READY')
UPDATE game_match SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{matchId} AND status IN ('READY', 'REST')

UPDATE game_match SET status = 'FINISHED', winner_user_id = #{winnerUserId}, player1_score = #{player1Score}, player2_score = #{player2Score}, finished_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{matchId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE game_match SET status = 'FINISHED', winner_user_id = #{winnerUserId}, player1_score = #{player1Score}, player2_score = #{player2Score}, finished_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{matchId} AND status IN ('READY', 'RUNNING')
UPDATE game_round SET status = 'FINISHED', winner_user_id = #{winnerUserId}, rest_until = NULL, finished_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{roundId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE game_match SET player1_score = #{player1Score}, player2_score = #{player2Score} WHERE id = #{matchId}
UPDATE game_round SET state_json = #{stateJson}, state_version = #{stateVersion}, move_count = GREATEST(move_count, #{actionCount}) WHERE id = #{roundId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM game_round WHERE match_id = #{matchId} ORDER BY game_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM game_round WHERE match_id = #{matchId} ORDER BY game_no ASC
SELECT * FROM game_round WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY started_at ASC
SELECT move_no, user_id, x, y, action, from_x, from_y, piece_type, piece_color, captured_piece_type, captured_piece_color FROM game_move WHERE round_id = #{roundId} ORDER BY move_no ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE game_round SET ready_user_ids = #{readyUserIds} WHERE id = #{roundId}
